_doc: Analysed reference images. Hash = first 16 hex of sha256. ref-check.mjs compares asset/reference/ against this list; an unlisted or changed file must be classified (workflows/reference-analysis.md) before it may influence a brief. class: CORE = defines the style; VARIATION = same style, extra evidence; OUTLIER = different style, never a style source. Cells of the pig sheet are 256x256 on a 6x4 grid: cell = c<col>r<row>, box = [col*256, row*256, 256, 256] (widen by 40 px when cutting).

files.role: Building/prop style source; top row = the 4 P0 breed pigs (same style as the pig sheet).
Rejected painterly style (art standard §1, §6.2): big head ~1:1.1, sketch texture, baked captions and scene props. Use only as a list of failure modes.
